Chevron, Occidental Petroleum, ConocoPhillips, and Halliburton all maintain significant operations here, competing for skilled professionals to lead complex capital projects. Current expansions—including ConocoPhillips and ExxonMobil's Permian Basin operational growth in the Midland area—require project managers who can coordinate teams, budgets, and timelines across multimillion-dollar initiatives. Beyond energy, Midland Memorial Hospital's facility expansion projects and the Midland International Air and Space Port infrastructure work demonstrate that construction, healthcare, and public-sector organizations also actively hire for project leadership roles.

Project manager compensation in Midland tends to run higher than many other Texas metros, driven by the concentration of oil and gas operators and service companies competing for skilled talent—making the investment in certification especially worthwhile. content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Midland

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. PMI sets specific thresholds based on your degree level and years of direct project-leadership experience. Review PMI's official eligibility criteria, then contact Granite PM Academy to confirm your qualifications before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's PMI-authorized live-virtual instructor-led course. This structured training covers all five process groups and ten knowledge areas tested on the PMP exam. Our Midland-based instructors deliver the full curriculum in an interactive format that fits working professionals' schedules.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, apply directly to PMI through their online portal. Submit proof of your education and project experience, then pay the examination fee to PMI. Granite PM Academy staff will guide you through the submission process and answer questions about required documentation.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Study using Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice tests, and instructor feedback sessions. Once PMI approves your application, schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a testing center in the Midland area or online. Our team provides targeted review to build confidence in exam domains.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Upon passing, you'll hold the PMP designation for three years. During each three-year renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through continuing education, volunteering, and professional involvement. Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and workshops to support your ongoing credential maintenance and career growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
